system.description:
When you choose this style starting at 3rd level, you have focused your effort on harnessing your innate element. If you have access to one or more nature releases already, select one. It becomes your chosen nature release that this and other feature from this subclass references.

If you do not have access to one, you may select one (Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, or Lightning Release). You gain the ability to learn and cast jutsu with the corresponding keyword.

Taijutsu you cast gains the chosen nature release keyword, if they don’t have one already.

By spending 1 Martial Dice, as a Bonus Action, you enhance your body with the Chakra of your chosen Nature release putting you into your Elemental Cloak state for the next minute or until you spend a bonus action to end it early. Once you enter this state, you cannot do so again until you spend at least 10 minutes of uninterrupted meditating.

Elemental Finisher

Taijutsu you cast with the Finisher keyword that are changed to become an Elemental Finisher gains the effects of the corresponding nature release.

Earth Release: You strike the ground creating a massive tectonic shift. All creatures in a 20-foot radius, centering on a point of the space you are occupying must make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (your choice). On a failed save, they take your [Unarmed Damage] + earth damage equal to the rank of the Jutsu cast, are knocked prone, and you create an area of difficult terrain equal to the rank the jutsu cast. Hostiles who attempt to move through this terrain must also pass a Perception check vs your Save DC or take earth damage equal to half of the rank the Jutsu was cast, taking none on a successful save. (D-Rank: 2d4, 20ft, C-Rank: 4d4, 25ft, B-Rank: 6d4, 30ft A-Rank: 8d4 35ft, S-Rank: 10d4, 40ft)

Wind Release: You strike forward, creating a spear, bullet or blast of wind targeting a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged Taijutsu attack that cannot be made at disadvantage, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + wind damage equal to the rank of the jutsu cast. Regardless of a hit or miss, you gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed until the end of your next turn. (D-Rank: 3d8, C-Rank: 5d8, B-Rank: 7d8, A-Rank: 9d8, S-Rank: 11d8)

Fire Release: You release a blazing torrent of flame that smolders and explodes forward like a burning missile targeting a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged Taijutsu attack that cannot be made at disadvantage dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + fire damage equal to the rank of the jutsu cast. On a hit, all creatures, except the original target within a 10-foot radius, centered on the target creature must also make a Dexterity or Constitution (your choice) saving throw, taking the rank-based fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. (D-Rank: 2d6+2, C-Rank: 4d6+4, B-Rank: 6d6+6, A-Rank: 8d6+8, S-Rank: 10d6+10)

Water Release: You unleash a torrent of crashing waves, overwhelming everyone in your path. All creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength or Constitution saving throw (your choice). On a failure, you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + cold damage equal to the rank of the jutsu cast blasting the creature to the far edge of the cone, and knocking them prone. Whether they succeed or fail, the overwhelming surge can rip weapons from their grasp, disarming any items they are holding. Structures hit by this jutsu are treated as vulnerable to its damage. (D-Rank: 2d6, C-Rank: 4d6, B-Rank: 6d6, A-Rank: 8d6, S-Rank: 10d6)

Lightning Release: You blitz forward like a flash of light and strike with enough kinetic force to penetrate stone, steel and chakra-based defenses in a single strike. Make a melee Taijutsu attack dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + lightning damage equal to the rank of the jutsu cast. If this attack scores a critical hit, you can recast it as a finisher, targeting a different creature. (D-Rank: 3d8, C-Rank: 5d8, B-Rank: 7d8, A-Rank: 9d8, S-Rank: 11d8)
